This is the fourth public release candidate of the NPMplus Security Fork. It is intended for test servers before a stable release.

### What changed since RC3

- Fixed the private-LAN dashboard listener failing during reboot when systemd tried to bind port 81 before DHCP assigned the VM's address.
- Added `FreeBind` plus explicit network-online ordering to the installer-managed LAN listener; existing RC3 listeners are migrated by Safe update.
- Fixed the host CrowdSec firewall bouncer configuration rejected by current packages because its required logging mode was absent.
- Added a bounded systemd startup gate so the host firewall bouncer waits for the containerized CrowdSec LAPI after reboot.
- Made fresh installation fail visibly if the firewall bouncer does not validate or start, instead of silently continuing without kernel-level enforcement.
- Expanded the CrowdSec doctor and boot trace to report the LAN listener and firewall-bouncer configuration, status, and boot logs.
- Updated Compose hardening syntax to the current `no-new-privileges=true` form and added CI coverage for both reboot defects and their upgrade repairs.

### Install or update a test VM

Copy and paste the complete command:

```bash
wget -qO setup-npmplus.sh https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/releases/download/v2.15.1-mangyan1.rc.4/setup-npmplus.sh &&
wget -qO setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/releases/download/v2.15.1-mangyan1.rc.4/setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 &&
sha256sum -c setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 &&
sudo bash setup-npmplus.sh
```

Choose **Install NPMplus** for a fresh test VM or **Safe update** for an existing installer-managed test VM. Safe update repairs the RC3 LAN listener and firewall-bouncer configuration before taking the normal snapshot, health-checking the deployment, and retaining automatic rollback protection.

Please report problems through [GitHub issues](https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/issues). Report security vulnerabilities privately through the repository Security page.
